name: Metastaz
source:
This is Slavya's bad ending from Slavya's own perspective.
It is a complete deconstruction of the original Slavya route by adding a single variable to the plot, which will allow you to look at Slavya's behavior from a completely different angle. An attempt to succinctly and concisely explain all the actions and oddities associated with Slavya-chan's behavior.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836801737]Steam[/url]]
translation:
从斯拉维亚自己的角度来看，这是斯拉维亚的坏结局。
它是对原始Slavya路线的完全解构，通过在情节中添加单个变量，这将允许你从完全不同的角度看待Slavya的行为。试图简洁明了地解释与Slavya-chan的行为相关的所有行为和奇怪行为。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836801737]Steam[/url]]
